UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account profile isolated to the authenticated owner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

email.description: Lowercase email address of the user.

avatarColor.description: Hex color for the user avatar.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserDirectoryEntry.title: UserDirectoryEntry
UserDirectoryEntry.description: Directory entry keyed by normalized email hash/slug for bilateral sharing handshake.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this directory entry.

name.description: Public display name for family invitations.

connectionsJson.description: Serialized sharing connections for bilateral reconciliation.

WorkspaceSlice.title: WorkspaceSlice
WorkspaceSlice.description: A private or shared module workspace slice containing household calendar, shopping, todos, notes, recipes, budget, and photos.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator of the workspace slice.

memberEmails.description: Bounded list of up to 10 normalized member email addresses permitted to access this workspace.

updatedBy.description: Display name of the member who last updated the workspace.

lastActionType.description: Category of the most recent change.

lastActionSummary.description: Human-readable summary of the most recent change.

sliceJson.description: Serialized workspace slice data bounded under Firestore 1MB limit.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Strictly private user profile document accessible only by the authenticated owner (userId == request.auth.uid).

/userDirectory/{directoryId}.description: Single-document lookup directory keyed by sanitized email ID for bilateral family connection handshakes.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Private (`priv_<id>`) or shared (`shared_<id>`) workspace slices accessible only by the owner or explicitly listed memberEmails.
